notes.title: Bug Fix + Next Game + Form for Next Game
notes.notes:
There was a crash that you could access very easily in the library. 

Oops.

Now there isn't.

Gamemaker won't let me compile the project files for Deepwell anymore. Thankfully, all this bugfix required me to do is change a couple lines in the dialogue file, but if I ever need to do something more intensive than that I am screwed.

Deepwell will not receive any more content updates, because I have been working on a new game.

It's very different from Deepwell. Mainly because I plan to make it not suck dick.
